facts.fact: 周五下午三点，总部星巴克空无一人。
facts.anchor: It was 3:00 o’clock on Friday afternoon, so the Headquarters Starbucks was deserted.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说 ARISTOTLE 曾试图辞职一次。
facts.anchor: “He tried to resign once,” he said.

facts.fact: ARISTOTLE 刚起步时，Alice G. PEACHTREE 把他送进 BUTTONFLY 的圈子。
facts.anchor: The lovely and brilliant Alice G. PEACHTREE sent him into my orbit

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 断言：若无来自高层的直接命令，他们绝不会做出那种事。
facts.anchor: There’s just no way they would have done what they did absent a direct order, and from high up.

facts.fact: IOD 军官告知 KRAY：大约五个月前，该通讯系统上两打（24 名）伊朗特工突然停止通讯。
facts.anchor: About five months ago two dozen Iranian agents on that commo system suddenly stopped communicating.

facts.fact: KRAY 骂那名 IOD 军官「You’re a sick fuck」，说完就走。
facts.anchor: “You’re a sick fuck,” KRAY said, walking out.

facts.fact: D. B. Cooper 把 KRAY 拉到一边，转述 Wacker 的说法：GOOWIKI 名下已有部署。
facts.anchor: Cooper, took me aside and told me Wacker said there had already been deployments under GOOWIKI.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 对 Andre 连说两遍法语「Mais oui」，点题「说法语」。
